author: GoPro
description:
Andy Bracco jumped from 25,000ft, where the air was so thin that he needed supplemental oxygen 😮‍💨. This decreased air density is what allowed him to push the limits of speed skydiving, reaching 386mph at the peak of his head-down dive.

🏆 $500 GoPro Award
🎥 Shot on our 360 camera, GoPro MAX2
